question: Where is fast food restaurant situated within 170 kilometers along the travel path toward Homewood Suites, Needham, MA from Cyrus Dallin Art Museum, Arlington, MA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.15241 42.415769)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.221587 42.300706)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.15241 42.415769)',4326)::geography, 170000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.15241 42.415769)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

[3].display_name: Cyrus Dallin Art Museum, Arlington, MA
